summary: A World Premiere archetype: LIGHT Fairy Synchro Monsters with ZERO Main Deck monsters at all. Built around a floating chessboard Field Spell that shuttles chess-piece monsters between the Extra Deck, Monster Zones, and Spell & Trap Zone — parked there as Continuous Spells that gain static effects, mirroring a chessboard's back rank. Note: 'Angelechy' and 'the chess archetype' are the same thing, not two separate archetypes.

cards.name: Angelechy Problem
cards.effectText: Once per turn: You can discard 1 Spell/Trap; Special Summon 1 Level 2 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck, and if you do, place 1 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck to your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. If a face-up "Angelechy" Monster Card(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can return 1 "Angelechy" Monster Card you own from your Spell & Trap Zone to the Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon it.

cards.name: Angelechy Shatranga
cards.effectText: 1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners. The 'King' piece. You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; banish it. If this card is placed in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell: You can add 1 "Angelechy" Trap from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Angelechy Shatranga" once per turn. While this card is treated as a Continuous Spell, your opponent can only attempt to activate up to 5 monster effects per turn.

cards.name: Angelechy Bastion
cards.effectText: 1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners. The 'Rook' piece. You can target 1 other card in this card's column; banish it. If this card is placed in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell: You can place 1 "Angelechy Shatranga" from your Extra Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Angelechy Bastion" once per turn. While this card is treated as a Continuous Spell, other "Angelechy" cards on the field cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

cards.name: Angelechy Destrier
cards.effectText: 1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners. The 'Knight' piece. You can target 1 monster in another column; banish it. If this card is placed in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell: You can add 1 "Angelechy" Spell from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Angelechy Destrier" once per turn. While this card is treated as a Continuous Spell, each time your opponent activates a card or effect, inflict 500 damage to your opponent when it resolves.

cards.name: Angelechy Enlisted
cards.effectText: 1 Tuner + 1 non-Tuner. The 'Pawn' piece. You can target 1 opponent's monster in this card's adjacent column; banish it, then change control of this card by moving it to one of your opponent's Main Monster Zones in this card's adjacent columns. If the control of this face-up card changes: Return this card to the Extra Deck, then the owner of this card Special Summons 1 "Angelechy" monster from their Extra Deck — the pawn 'promotes' after capturing. You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Enlisted" once per turn.

cards.name: Angelechy Opening to e4
cards.effectText: If your opponent goes first, you can also activate this card from your hand during the Standby Phase of their first turn. Place 1 "Angelechy" Field Spell from your hand, Deck, or GY, face-up on your field, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Level 2 or 7 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck to the Extra Monster Zone, and if you do that, place 1 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. Until the end of your next turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters.

cards.name: Angelechy Disturbance
cards.effectText: Give control of 1 "Angelechy" monster you control to your opponent (until the End Phase), then if your opponent controls a face-up card(s) in its adjacent Monster Zones and/or Spell & Trap Zones, their effects are negated. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Angelechy" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, except "Angelechy Disturbance". You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Disturbance" once per turn.

comboLines.title: Chessboard back-rank setup
comboLines.body: Angelechy Opening to e4 — activatable from hand during your opponent's first Standby Phase if they went first — fetches the Angelechy Problem Field Spell, drops a Level 2 (Enlisted) or 7 (Destrier) piece into the Extra Monster Zone, AND parks another piece in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell. From there Problem's once-per-turn discard keeps developing: Bastion as a Continuous Spell protects the board and places Shatranga; Destrier chips 500 damage per opponent activation; Shatranga caps your opponent at 5 monster-effect attempts per turn. Enlisted 'captures' by banishing in an adjacent column, hands itself to the opponent, then bounces to the Extra Deck and promotes into a bigger piece. Note Opening to e4 locks you to Synchro Monsters from the Extra Deck until the end of your next turn.

sampleDecklist.label: Early theorycraft build — Angelechy is a World Premiere archetype only days old. Card names and stats verified against the card database, and the list checked against the May 18, 2026 TCG Forbidden & Limited List. Some builds pair this shell with a Synchron sub-engine instead of the pure Spell/Trap shell shown here.
